jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - AI
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Variantly is a global software company offering an ecosystem of products and services that serve as a growth engine for top mobile-first businesses worldwide. Our ecosystem includes:

  • Variantly Acquire, a platform for automating and optimizing Apple Ads. 

  • Variantly Agency, a full-service mobile marketing agency staffed by top experts.

  • Variantly Optimize, an A/B testing platform recognized as the ASO Tool of the Year.

  • Store Radar by Variantly: an ASO platform with advanced keyword and competitor insights.

Why Variantly? 

  • For over 11 years, we’ve been at the forefront of the mobile marketing industry, building an ecosystem of market-leading technologies.

  • An Apple Ads Partner, Variantly is the 1st company to build the Apple Ads management platform. 

  • Working with top mobile companies and brands globally: Skyscanner, Glovo, Flo, Babbel, Wooga and many more.

  • Generating an impressive transaction volume, with over $1 billion in ad spend flowing through our ecosystem.

  • Integrated AI into our strategic approach since 2023.

  • Effectively collaborate across 20+ countries with a remote-first and supportive culture.

About the role:

We’re looking for an AI Product Manager to own and evolve our AI-powered product that helps customers scale and optimize their advertising performance.

A high-impact, high-ownership role at the intersection of AI, data, and real customer workflows, with strong influence on product direction.

Why this is a game-changing role?

  • We’re heavily investing in AI and building products powered by LLMs and machine learning — this role leads the charge on innovation.

  • You’ll collaborate with strong, self-driven engineering teams that value product leadership.

  • You’ll operate in a fast-moving AI landscape, where staying ahead of trends matters.

  • Exposure to high-profile global clients and the opportunity to build strategic, long-term partnerships.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Define and evolve the product vision and roadmap for our AI experiences, including Agentic AI, driving app growth.

  • Drive rapid iterations based on customer feedback and product data.

  • Work closely with engineering teams to deliver scalable, high-impact AI capabilities.

  • Improve how the AI product experience and agentic AI works — from expanding accessible datasets to refining response quality and user workflows.

  • Lead product discovery through customer interviews, beta programs, and analytics (SQL, Amplitude, BI tools).

  • Partner with Customer Success, Marketing, and C-level stakeholders to align product direction with business goals.

  • Continuously monitor AI/LLM trends and translate them into product opportunities.

About you:

  • Proven track record of launching and scaling B2B or core tool-based products with measurable business impact.

  • Experience with AI-powered or ML-driven products and understanding of how non-deterministic systems work.

  • Strong analytical skills and confidence working with product data and analytics tools.

  • Ability to deeply understand customer workflows and build products that integrate seamlessly into them.

  • Technical fluency and comfort collaborating with engineers on architecture, logic, and data flows.

  • Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity and early-stage product environments.

  • Strong product intuition combined with a structured, metrics-first mindset.

  • Active interest in AI trends and emerging technologies.

  • Fluent English (C1+).

Who this role is NOT for:

  • If your background is primarily in growth or marketing rather than core product ownership.

  • If you prefer predictable, deterministic systems over experimental AI environments.

  • If you’re used to highly structured, slow-moving organizations.

  • If you haven’t owned products end-to-end with clear business impact.

What is there for you?

  • Time Off: Vacation and public holidays following your country's regulations. Additional PTOs annually for personal rejuvenation.

  • Health and Wellness: Medical insurance or health care compensation. Paid sick leave to prioritize your well-being.

  • Professional Development: Top online/offline conferences and mobile industry events. Internal courses for continuous professional development.

  • Performance and Growth: Micro-management-free and supportive management style. Semi-annual performance review sessions. New career opportunities through our internal mobility program.

  • Team Engagement: Corporate online events and offline team retreats. Collaboration between teams through shared OKRs. Environment conducive to open dialogue and constructive feedback.

  • Work Flexibility: Flexible working schedule for a better work-life balance. Remote-first working environment.

  • Workspace Options: Coworking costs coverage program. Office hubs in key locations for a convenient and productive work environment.

Our Culture

At Variantly, our values are not just words — they guide everything we do. To achieve our ambitious goals and maintain success, we stand united by our core behaviors:

  • Move Fast

  • Get Sh*t Done

  • Build Together

  • Strive for Transparency

  • Own What You Do

  • Learn + Share = Excel

Remote Hiring Guidelines: At Variantly, we welcome team members from various countries. While all our roles are remote, certain positions may have specific eligibility requirements based on location. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

jobs.descriptionHtml:

About the role:

We're looking for a strategic and hands-on VP of Marketing to lead marketing at Variantly and help drive the next stage of the company's growth.

In this role, you'll own our marketing strategy across brand, positioning, demand generation, content, and go-to-market execution.

Reporting directly to the CEO and leading a team of 8 across Demand Generation, Content, and Design, you'll partner closely with Product, Sales, Customer Success, and the leadership team to drive awareness, pipeline, and revenue growth.

Why you'll love this role:

  • Opportunity to define new positioning and shape the future narrative.

  • Launch and scale new GenAI-powered products.

  • Significant ownership across brand, demand generation, product marketing, and growth.

  • Freedom to build and scale PLG initiatives with substantial room for experimentation and impact.

  • Opportunity to implement and scale an AI-first marketing stack.

  • Work with some of the world's leading brands and mobile-first companies.

  • Collaborate closely with an experienced executive team, including the CEO, CPO, and CRO.

What you'll be doing:

  • Define and execute the overall marketing strategy to support company growth, market expansion, and revenue objectives.

  • Lead the evolution of the Variantly brand across the US and Europe, including positioning, messaging, market narrative, and brand awareness.

  • Own demand generation and pipeline growth across Mid-Market and Enterprise segments.

  • Drive go-to-market strategy and execution for existing products, new product launches, and portfolio-wide initiatives.

  • Build and scale product marketing capabilities, ensuring clear communication of product value, differentiation, and customer outcomes.

  • Own the website experience, conversion funnels, SEO/AEO strategy, and conversion rate optimization initiatives.

  • Lead content strategy, creation, and distribution across the customer journey to support awareness, demand generation, and product adoption.

  • Drive PR, thought leadership, industry visibility, events, and strategic partnerships, including relationships with key ecosystem partners.

  • Partner closely with Product, Sales, and Customer Success to align growth initiatives and maximize business impact.

  • Lead, develop, and scale a high-performing marketing organization.

About you:

  • 10+ years of B2B SaaS marketing experience, including 5+ years of experience leading marketing teams in high-growth technology companies.

  • Strong experience across demand generation, brand, content, and GTM strategy.

  • Demonstrated experience leveraging AI to improve marketing effectiveness across demand generation, content, growth, and go-to-market initiatives.

  • Experience marketing multi-product platforms or product ecosystems is a strong plus.

  • Track record of building marketing programs that drive pipeline and revenue growth.

  • Strong analytical mindset, comfortable with metrics, attribution and use of data to improve performance and efficiency.

  • Excellent leadership, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

  • Fluent written and spoken English (C1+).

What is there for you?

  • Time Off: Vacation and public holidays following your country's regulations. Additional PTOs annually for personal rejuvenation.

  • Health and Wellness: Medical insurance or health care compensation. Paid sick leave to prioritize your well-being.

  • Professional Development: Top online/offline conferences and mobile industry events. Internal courses for continuous professional development.

  • Performance and Growth: Micro-management-free and supportive management style. Semi-annual performance review sessions. New career opportunities through our internal mobility program.

  • Team Engagement: Corporate online events and offline team retreats. Collaboration between teams through shared OKRs. Environment conducive to open dialogue and constructive feedback.

  • Work Flexibility: Flexible working schedule for a better work-life balance. Remote-first working environment.

  • Workspace Options: Coworking costs coverage program. Office hubs in key locations for a convenient and productive work environment.

Our Culture

At Variantly, our values are not just words — they guide everything we do. To achieve our ambitious goals and maintain success, we stand united by our core behaviors:

  • Get Sh*t Done

  • Build Together

  • Strive for Transparency

  • Own What You Do

  • Learn + Share = Excel

jobs.title: Associate Graphic Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Variantly is a global software company offering an ecosystem of products and services that serve as a growth engine for top mobile-first businesses worldwide. Our ecosystem includes:

  • Variantly Acquire, a platform for automating and optimizing Apple Ads. 

  • Variantly Agency, a full-service mobile marketing agency staffed by top experts.

  • Variantly Optimize, an A/B testing platform recognized as the ASO Tool of the Year.

  • Store Radar by Variantly: an ASO platform with advanced keyword and competitor insights.

Why Variantly? 

  • For over 11 years, we’ve been at the forefront of the mobile marketing industry, building an ecosystem of market-leading technologies.

  • An Apple Ads Partner, Variantly is the 1st company to build the Apple Ads management platform. 

  • Working with top mobile companies and brands globally: Skyscanner, Glovo, Flo, Babbel, Wooga and many more.

  • Generating an impressive transaction volume, with over $1 billion in ad spend flowing through our ecosystem.

  • Integrated AI into our strategic approach since 2023.

  • Effectively collaborate across 20+ countries with a remote-first and supportive culture.

We are looking for a Graphic Designer who will be a vital engine for scaling our visual assets at Variantly Agency team. If you are fast, detail-oriented, accurate with visual standards, and looking for a role with a clear path toward high-level creative ownership, we’d love to hear from you.

In this role, you will:

  • Scale & adapt: execute fast, high-volume resizes and localizations of App Store/Google Play screenshots and promotional assets across various formats.

  • Maintain visual consistency: ensure absolute brand and technical alignment for all resized and localized assets without compromising visual quality or strict technical guidelines.

  • Support UA & ASO teams: deliver ready-to-use production assets on time to help performance and optimization teams hit their goals.

  • Evolve & take ownership: gradually move from production support to end-to-end ownership of design tasks and minor creative initiatives as your operational efficiency grows.

  • Assist agency needs: help with internal visual tasks and case study materials when needed.

What we're looking for:

  • Experience in creating marketing materials and promotional assets across various platforms and ad networks.

  • Ability to handle large volumes of resizes and layout adaptations quickly and without technical errors.

  • Hands-on experience with Figma and Adobe Creative Cloud (Photoshop, Illustrator).

  • Strong understanding of composition, typography, color theory, and technical specs for digital advertising channels.

  • Attention to detail: approach to maintaining grid alignment, visual hierarchy, and brand guidelines across variations.

  • English language skills: B1-B2 or above.

It would be nice if you have:

  • Experience preparing marketing graphics specifically for App Store & Google Play - huge plus.

  • Basic motion design or animation skills (After Effects).

  • Familiarity with UI/UX principles.

What is there for you?

  • Time Off: Vacation and public holidays following your country's regulations. Additional PTOs annually for personal rejuvenation.

  • Health and Wellness: Medical insurance or health care compensation. Paid sick leave to prioritize your well-being.

  • Professional Development: Top online/offline conferences and mobile industry events. Internal courses for continuous professional development.

  • Performance and Growth: Micro-management-free and supportive management style. Semi-annual performance review sessions. New career opportunities through our internal mobility program.

  • Team Engagement: Corporate online events and offline team retreats. Collaboration between teams through shared OKRs. Environment conducive to open dialogue and constructive feedback.

  • Work Flexibility: Flexible working schedule for a better work-life balance. Remote-first working environment.

  • Workspace Options: Coworking costs coverage program. Office hubs in key locations for a convenient and productive work environment.

At Variantly, our values are not just words — they guide everything we do. To achieve our ambitious goals and maintain success, we stand united by our core behaviors:

  • Get Sh*t Done

  • Build Together

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive
jobs.descriptionHtml:
Variantly is a global software company offering an ecosystem of products and services that serve as a growth engine for top mobile-first businesses worldwide. Our ecosystem includes:

  • Variantly Acquire, a platform for automating and optimizing Apple Ads. 

  • Variantly Agency, a full-service mobile marketing agency staffed by top experts.

  • Variantly Optimize, an A/B testing platform recognized as the ASO Tool of the Year.

  • Store Radar by Variantly: an ASO platform with advanced keyword and competitor insights.

Why Variantly? 

  • For over 11 years, we’ve been at the forefront of the mobile marketing industry, building an ecosystem of market-leading technologies.

  • An Apple Ads Partner, Variantly is the 1st company to build the Apple Ads management platform. 

  • Working with top mobile companies and brands globally: Skyscanner, Glovo, Flo, Babbel, Wooga and many more.

  • Generating an impressive transaction volume, with over $1 billion in ad spend flowing through our ecosystem.

  • Integrated AI into our strategic approach since 2023.

  • Effectively collaborate across 20+ countries with a remote-first and supportive culture.

As an Enterprise Account Executive EMEA/MENA, you will be responsible for the growth of our enterprise accounts in the region, ensuring all key metrics are delivered. With identified accounts, you will ensure revenue growth, customer success, and long-term customer partnership. In addition, you will provide direction and recommendations to the extended territory team and leadership to increase the region's efficiencies, structure, and strategy, ensuring individual and group success.


You will be accountable for excellence to:

  • Own the full sales cycle from prospecting and qualification through trial, negotiation, closing, and handover.

  • Consistently achieve and exceed new business targets.

  • Build and manage a healthy pipeline through self-generated opportunities.

  • Develop territory strategy and specific account plans, expand install base and acquire net new customers, create and execute demand generation plans within a territory, and be accountable for all aspects of taking down the number as if you genuinely owned Variantly.

  • Create a strong partnership with BDR, Marketing, Solutions, Product, Customer Success, Leadership and Legal to win strategic accounts.

  • Leverage internal and external tools to maximize customer information – Maximize success with a world-class SaaS toolkit (access to Gong, Hubspot, Linkedin Sales Navigator, AppMagic), and provide feedback on products regarding customers' issues and competitive trends.

  • Represent the company at industry events and conferences, building relationships and generating new business opportunities.

  • Maintain strong deal hygiene, forecasting accuracy, and CRM discipline.

  • Take ownership of performance, continuously improve sales skills, and actively seek and apply coaching and feedback.

About you:

We want to meet individuals passionate about the mobile marketing world, who have experience working with app publishers, agencies and brands and have a track record in owning large multi-year deals from end to end.

  • 3+ years of experience in sales roles, with a strong track record in mobile marketing or advertising technology.

  • A genuine passion for closing the deals with a ruthless focus on a customer.

  • Proven ability to sell complex SaaS solutions to multiple stakeholders and senior decision-makers.

  • A systematic approach in sales (MEDDIC).

  • Strong experience in outbound prospecting and pipeline generation.

  • A commitment to being an adviser and business development partner for a customer.

  • A consultative selling mindset - able to challenge customer thinking, uncover underlying business needs, and position solutions based on value and business impact.

  • Highly accountable, proactive, and results-oriented, with a strong sense of ownership.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

  • Curious, creative thinker, and open-minded character with a passion for challenges.

You'll research, prospect, and qualify opportunities that feed directly into the sales pipeline, working closely with Sales to convert interest into qualified meetings. Strong performers have a clear path to Account Executive.

In this role, you will:

  • Conduct company research based on Variantly' Ideal Customer Profile (ICP) and execute personalized, data-informed outreach to Enterprise and C-level contacts.

  • Qualify and follow up on inbound leads, quickly assessing fit and routing warm opportunities into the pipeline.

  • Utilize automation tools, cold calls, and custom emails to build and enrich the sales pipeline with new opportunities.

  • Run discovery and qualification calls with Enterprise companies and C-level titles to surface needs and hand qualified opportunities to the Sales Team.

  • Own pipeline and demos-booked targets on a monthly and quarterly basis, with a focus on quality over volume, contributing to team-wide KPIs.

  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date prospect and company records in HubSpot to track sales metrics and progress.

  • Collaborate closely with the Sales Team on outreach strategy, sharing feedback and refining messaging based on what's converting.

  • Actively participate in education sessions and training, and contribute expertise and best practices back to the Sales department.

About You:

  • Minimum 1 year of successful experience in a BDR or quota-carrying sales role, ideally including Enterprise or C-level outreach.

  • Track record across both outbound prospecting and inbound lead qualification.

  • Hands-on experience with multiple sales techniques — cold calls, personalized LinkedIn/email messaging, and discovery calls.

  • Experience with prospecting tools and a CRM (HubSpot a plus).

  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills.

  • Quick learner who adapts well to an ever-changing environment.

  • Time management skills and the ability to work independently or under supervision.

  • Coachable, resilient, and energized by feedback.

  • Comfortable operating with some ambiguity within an established, fast-moving team

Clear progression to Account Executive for BDRs who consistently hit pipeline and demo targets and demonstrate readiness for a full deal cycle. Specific AE-readiness milestones to be defined jointly with the AE team.

  • Work with data: pipelines, integration, analytics.

  • Enhance system reliability, security, and performance.

  • Develop, deploy, monitor, and maintain backend products.

  • Collaborate on building and scaling microservices-based solutions.

  • Conduct thorough code reviews within the domain and provide constructive feedback.

  • Work in and communicate with cross-functional teams (frontend, QA, product manager).

About you:

  • Have a proven experience in software development with over 4 years of professional expertise using Python.

  • Experience with Python Web frameworks (Django, FastAPI).

  • Experience with data storages like PostgreSQL (performance optimization).

  • Experience with async task queues (Celery, Redis, Kafka, RabbitMQ).

  • Experience in building solutions based on micro-services and scaling such systems.

  • Experience with Docker.

  • Familiarity with modern CI/CD approaches and tools.

  • Solid understanding of standard web technologies, including security principles.

  • Ability to make architecture decisions with a strong focus on business impact.

  • Experience working with StarRocks, Airflow, Kafka Connect.

  • Experience with Kubernetes, AWS infrastructure.
